🔥🇲🇽 THE REAL NARCO-GOVERNMENTS FLEW A PARTY LOGO: PAN

Morena's Ariadna Montiel laid out the record: El Chapo walked out of Puente Grande in 2001 under Fox and stayed free through all six years of Calderón — "for more than 12 years this crime boss was never captured." Calderón's own party ran one of Chapo's lovers for office, and his security chief Genaro García Luna now sits in a US federal prison, convicted of trafficking. Remember who lectures Mexico about "cartel links."

🔥🇲🇽 DEA DIRECTOR SMEARS MEXICO AS CARTEL-LINKED. THE LEDGER ANSWERS BACK.

DEA chief Terry Cole claimed a "connection" between Mexico's government and the cartels. The Security Cabinet answered with a ledger through June 30: 59,582 arrests, 31,366 guns seized, 498 tons of drugs, 2,363 kg of fentanyl, 2,627 labs dismantled, 80+ officials detained including 7 sitting mayors — homicides down 48% since September 2024. "There is no protection for anyone who breaks the law."

🚨🇲🇽 US TREASURY BRANDS TWO MORE MEXICAN CARTELS "TERRORISTS" — THE PRETEXT MACHINE ROLLS ON

Washington's Treasury added the Juárez Cartel and Los Viagras to its Foreign Terrorist Organization list today — the same "terrorist" tag Trump signed a secret order to send his military after on Mexican soil. Sheinbaum's line hasn't moved: cooperation yes, subordination never. Mexico's own results — homicides down 48%, 498 tons of drugs seized — never needed a US label to exist.

🚨🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM SENDS A NATIONAL FEMICIDE LAW TO CONGRESS — UP TO 70 YEARS

Sheinbaum signed and sent Congress a General Law on Femicide today, homologizing the crime across all 32 states with prison terms of 50 to 70 years and 19 aggravating factors — and creating a national registry for children orphaned by femicide. "I took on the responsibility of protecting women," she said. The first woman to govern Mexico is making the murder of women impossible to plea down to "homicide."

TEXAS PUBLIC RADIO: Mexico's Cattle Ranchers Fear Screwworm Could Permanently Reshape Cross-Border Trade
July 13, 2026 | 🟡

📰 The headline is Mexican ranchers "fear" — but the numbers underneath tell a different story. 🇲🇽

Mexican beef exports to the US rose 23% in early 2026 as Mexico built out its own feedlots; one Texas feedlot dropped from 40,000 head to about 4,000.

• Mexican beef exports "rose by 23% in the first four months of 2026"
• Texas feedlot pens that held tens of thousands "now sit largely empty"

WASHINGTON BLADE: Mexico's First Openly Gay Mayor Killed
July 14, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Benjamín Medrano, ex-mayor of Fresnillo, shot in a Guadalajara ice cream shop on July 7. The Blade frames it as proof anti-LGBTQ "violence and kidnappings are commonplace in Mexico." 🔍

Left out: Medrano publicly opposed same-sex marriage and pride parades, and faced a 60-million-peso fraud probe — context that complicates the martyr frame.

• "anti-LGBTQ violence and kidnappings are commonplace in Mexico"
• authorities "have also not made any arrests in connection with Medrano's murder"

CHATHAM HOUSE: US Refusal to Renew USMCA Brings Uncertainty — But the Treaty Is Far From Dead
July 14, 2026 | 🟢

📰 A London think tank states plainly what most US outlets buried: the pact stays in force, and Mexico steered talks toward "renegotiation rather than cancellation." 🇲🇽

Credits Mexico's approach as "relatively successful" — the leverage the doom coverage wrote out of the story.

• "conversations revolving around renegotiation rather than cancellation"
• Mexico "relatively successful" in preserving the free-trade framework

BREITBART: Mexican Government "Trashes" DEA Director Over "Baseless" Comments
July 15, 2026 | 🔴

📰 DEA's Terry Cole tells a Florida crowd there's a "deadly connection" between cartels and Mexican officials. Breitbart runs it as fact — and never once quotes what Cole actually said. 🔍

Mexico's Security Cabinet called the claim "baseless"; homicides are down 48% since Sept 2024 under the "zero impunity" strategy the speech ignored.

• "trashes DEA director over 'baseless' comments"
• DEA "would be going after public officials who helped cartels"

🇲🇽💵 <u>MEXICO'S INFLATION IS NOW LOWER THAN THE UNITED STATES'</u>

June inflation in Mexico came in at 3.37% — the lowest since December 2020 — while US consumer prices rose 3.5%. For the first time in years, the country Washington loves to lecture on "stability" is running cooler than the empire itself. Banxico's inflation light is green, and the peso closed the week gaining on a weakening dollar. (El Financiero)

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>48,000 LITERS OF STOLEN FUEL, ONE TANKER, ONE ROADSIDE STOP</u>

On the México–Querétaro highway, state police pulled over a tanker with mismatched plates and no paperwork — inside, 48,000 liters of illegal gasoline. The driver, Luis "N," 42, faces charges for illegal hydrocarbon transport and attacks on communication routes. Fuel theft that bled Pemex for years, stopped at the roadside.
